title: Chapter 347 Song Bo'S Fear
content:
Chapter 347 Song Bo'S Fear

Especially Swan, who looked at Wang Shuo with an unfriendly look. This guy just came here twice, and now he comes again?

It's clear that he has bad intentions.

"Everyone, I have a suggestion. There are three monsters here. Let's work together to kill them first, and then divide the monster pills equally, how about that?"

Wang Shuo was also a little puzzled for a while. Isn't the Shura Order in our hands more precious?

Why does it feel like everyone is fighting for these monster pills?

Is this the opponent's strategy of confusing the enemy? To paralyze himself?

No matter what, all the people and beasts here are potential enemies, that's right.

"What nonsense, that saber-toothed tiger was discovered by Swan and me first, and it must belong to us. As for the other two monsters, I'll give them to you."

The King Kong Barbie Wang Cuilian gestured with her fist in front of her chest to show her strength.

The bald man and the other two did not talk nonsense. Obviously, they have recognized Wang Cuilian's strength.

"New friend, what do you say?" The bald man was quite afraid when he saw Wang Shuo in armor.

People who can come here are basically not the kind of arrogant idiots.

In the War General Tower, the law of the jungle is implemented more thoroughly, and it has always been the law of the jungle.

Although Wang Shuo is alone, the equipment on his body has a huge deterrent effect on others.

You know, in Yingying Town, those who can really have a set of armor are all top-level warriors with strong combat power.

These people can summon the passage to the second floor at any time.

The reason why they have not gone to the second floor for a long time is that they just want to accumulate strength on the first floor, so as not to become the bottom of the second floor.

In the first floor of the War General Tower, top warriors rarely come to the wild.

Those who come out to hunt monsters are basically high-level generals.

And for ordinary high-level generals, it is already very good to have a gold-level weapon, unlike this kid, who is already armed to the teeth.

He really wants Wang Shuo to challenge a monster in order to test Wang Shuo's strength.

Only in this way can he be sure whether to attack Wang Shuo later.

"Haha, I don't care."

Everyone is a high-level general.

They are all on guard against each other.

Soon, the three forces have assigned their opponents.

The reason why Wang Shuo is willing to stay is that he wants to observe the generals here more, see how they fight, and know what they are doing.

Wang Shuo turned his head and looked at the red-haired baboon left for him.

To be on the safe side, Wang Shuo still summoned Da Huang.

This move, in the eyes of Song Bo and others, made them serious about Wang Shuo again.

You know, among the masters of Yingying Town, there are not many summoned beasts at the gold boss level.

Wang Shuo rode on Da Huang, his strength reached the maximum, and he immediately attacked the red-haired baboon.

The other few people did not hesitate and started fighting each other.

Although there is no data, Wang Shuo can still use the skills.

It is still Wang Shuo's usual attack route.

With the powerful inner strength of the Black Dragon Sutra and the help of Da Huang, Wang Shuo actually felt that he could completely defeat this boss.

This made Wang Shuo feel a little happy.

He had never fought a golden boss-level monster before.

He had fought a high-level undead general in several wars against the undead.

At that time, he didn't have any special feelings on the battlefield, he just knew how to kill.

At this time, fighting with the red-haired baboon, the experience seemed to be more profound.

He could analyze his own skills and consciously predict the opponent's attack.

It turned out that many skills had already been integrated into his instincts.
